capabilities: Move the current line up or down, swapping it with the neighboring line and leaving children, blank lines and nesting untouched
Indent or outdent only the current line while children keep their indent
Move or indent several selected lines as a block
Keep each command a single undo step with the cursor on the same character
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. It sets no hotkeys itself (users assign them and must remove the built-in bindings first), has no settings, and works on desktop and mobile with no network access.
intentEvidence: Obsidian 1.15 changed Move line up/down and indenting when Smart lists is on
motivation: The author built it because the 1.15 behavior change 'broke a lot of keyboard habits' and they wanted the old line-only commands back.
problem: Obsidian 1.15's Smart lists changed Move line up/down and indenting to move whole list subtrees and jump blank lines, breaking established keyboard habits.
summary: Set of four commands that move or indent only the current or selected lines, ignoring list structure as Obsidian did before 1.15.
